Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was quite complicated. We had book appointments (which were only available during class hours) a few times, no one helped with the virtual campus or finding anything, online nor physical. Then we has to go to the police station, which was a mess and impossible to get an appointment without a spanish phone number?
